title: jmap-server: fix the comment above error_invocation (JmapError fields)
description: The source comment above error_invocation in jmap-server describes JmapError's fields as String/Option<String>/Option<Id>; actual fields are a type string, optional string and integer fields and a string-keyed extra map. Also: 16 redundant_explicit_links and a few unescaped [RFC..] / <name> warnings under cargo doc --document-private-items (metadata-server validate.rs:74, contacts-server helpers.rs:284, mail-server project.rs:212, filter.rs:410).
